scope: Bounded manual/fixture implementation and integration; not live-source, legal, empirical-recall or methodological-adequacy certification

requests.request: Inspect graph support, depth, input-order determinism, resource ceilings, identifiers and API behavior without editing or running Cargo
Assess SR-042/043 manual/fixture acceptance, source-specific reporting, authority boundaries and assertion-level test evidence without live execution

preserved_findings.finding: Prior traversal propagated over-depth evidence and depended on edge order
preserved_findings.resolution: Use shortest prefix/reverse distances to identify exactly the edges supporting bounded walks; exhaustive graph oracle passes

preserved_findings.finding: Fan-in/fan-out evidence amplification was not bounded by maximum_records
preserved_findings.resolution: Select retained candidates before evidence materialisation; enforce shared work and evidence-membership budgets with whole-call failure

preserved_findings.finding: Citing identifiers admitted controls; seeds and identifier bytes were unbounded
preserved_findings.resolution: Validate tokens, bound seed count, individual/aggregate identifier bytes and custom-method labels

preserved_findings.finding: Privacy screening omitted log/candidate identifiers and coverage rationales
preserved_findings.resolution: Apply bounded identifier and sensitive-pattern screening; preserve its non-de-identification limitation; regression assertions pass

preserved_findings.finding: Contact and coverage assertions referenced a static checker that did not execute their behavior
preserved_findings.resolution: Map exact runtime tests and add reciprocal execution/method mismatch/duplicate-log regressions

preserved_findings.finding: New limits, bounded-walk semantics and agent/owner boundaries needed documentation
preserved_findings.resolution: Document exact ceilings, whole-call errors, unchanged wire schema, historical simulation and owner-only decision authority

re_review: Both reviewing agents reported no remaining blocking finding within their source-review scopes after fixes. They did not execute Cargo, validate live policies or authorize promotion.
additional_oracle: Correctness reviewer independently compared the distance criterion with exhaustive walks on 1200 deterministic random graphs with 2-6 nodes, depths 1-5 and multiple seeds; all matched. This Python oracle is supplementary, not Rust execution evidence.
authority: Historical simulated-panel receipts remain unchanged. New agent reviews are advisory; the owner alone decides promotion. Full-workspace, hosted and merged evidence remain separate.
